_comment: Which changes may merge without a person (docs/AUTONOMY.md §5, docs/PLAN.md §8-3, operator 2026-10-23). A pull request is `auto` only when every file it changes matches an `auto` pattern and none matches a `human` one; anything unlisted is `human`. Decided by this table and scripts/autonomy-class.mjs in CI, never by the agent that wrote the change. `**` is any path, `*` any name within one folder. Changing this file is itself `human`.
_owner: Of the `human` paths, the ones a spoken OK does not release (scripts/owner-ok.mjs, docs/AUTONOMY.md §5): the rules themselves, the gate, the ledger, the link and the kill list. Only the owner's own account takes these in.
